split_lineage: REPLACE_WITH_TEAM_ORIGINAL_SPLIT_ARTIFACT_AND_REVISION; join existing query_id assignments, do not resplit

environment.databricks_runtime: REPLACE_WITH_EXACT_RUNTIME_VERSION; repository CI currently targets 14.3 LTS / Spark 3.5.0 / Scala 2.12
environment.compute: REPLACE_WITH_NODE_TYPE_WORKER_COUNT_AND_ACCESS_MODE; requires classic dedicated/single-user compute with Spark JVM access
environment.benchmark_jar: REPLACE_WITH_BUILT_JAR_COMMIT_AND_LIBRARY_PATH; attach to compute before starting the notebook
environment.ml_environment: REPLACE_WITH_EXISTING_MODEL_TRAINING_ENVIRONMENT_VERSIONS; reuse team LightGBM and feature dependencies
environment.raw_format: REPLACE_COLUMNS_DELIMITER_AND_OPTIONAL_WEIGHT_COLUMN_FROM_ACTUAL_POINT_DATA; Spark inputs must not contain appended synopsis records
environment.feature_contract: team_features.extract(query, estimate, histogram, sources) must reuse the team's online feature computation and return a dictionary with the exact model feature names; no labels or feature tables
environment.skewness_shape: All-three example requires a square merged histogram. Remove skewness for rectangular grids until the existing core density-indexing defect is separately fixed.
environment.cache_conditions: No raw DataFrame persistence requested. OS, cloud-storage and Databricks I/O caches are not flushed. Record relevant cluster cache settings; do not label this cold-cache.
